exposure: trial of labour after cesarean delivery (TOLAC)
outcome: Surgical injury during intrapartum cesarean delivery
cohort: 60 randomly selected charts of viable, singleton pregnancies undergoing trial of labor after cesarean delivery (TOLAC) from January 1, 2016, to December 31, 2018
finding: This quality improvement initiative identified areas for improvement in consent for TOLAC, duration of dystocia before decision to proceed with cesarean delivery and delay to cesarean delivery, and peripartum complications.
